as_told.title: Kelly Johnson and Lockheed crew see elliptical object

plain: Kelly Johnson, the aircraft designer who led Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret aircraft design shop, is said to have watched a strange black object in the sky one evening. Michels passes on Johnson's own account: at about 5 p.m. Johnson was looking out a large west-facing window, watching the sunset, when he saw "this black thing." A researcher named Marik von Rennenkampff tells it without naming a source. He calls Johnson "the most well-known aeronautical engineer in American history" and places him at his ranch in Southern California near the Channel Islands. In his version the object was elliptical and a Lockheed crew saw it too. Told this way, the story puts one of America's most respected aircraft designers among the people who saw something they could not explain.
